sections.heading: A candidate {{entity_noun}} qualifies only if ALL of these conditions hold for it:

rules.text: At least one {{entity_noun}} can be identified from the phrase and its relationship summary.

The phrase and its relationship summary show real, concrete involvement with the identified {{entity_noun}}: some party is shown to {{entity_relationships.base}} that {{entity_noun}}, not merely to name, list, or mention it in passing.

It is the manufacturer itself that {{entity_relationships.third_person}} the identified {{entity_noun}} — not a customer, supplier, distributor, or other third party that the manufacturer merely relates to.

sections.heading: A candidate {{entity_noun}} is ruled out if ANY of these guards is violated by it. Ruling out one candidate does not reject the phrase — another candidate may still qualify:

rules.text: The manufacturer's involvement in the identified {{entity_noun}} is only aspirational, hoped-for, planned, or discontinued, rather than current and actual.
